preconditions.description: Attacker must have some TST token balance to initiate the attack
Contract must be in unrestricted state (unrestricted = true)

exploit_hint: The approve() function has a race condition vulnerability due to the requirement 'allowed[msg.sender][_spender] == 0 || _value == 0'. An attacker can front-run a victim's approval transaction: 1) First approve a small amount to establish allowance, 2) When victim tries to approve a larger amount, front-run with approve(0) to reset allowance to 0, 3) Then approve a large amount again before victim's transaction executes, allowing the attacker to steal tokens via transferFrom() from the victim's account.
